question: Which is the best-selling product?
sql:
SELECT
    p.ICODE,
    p.DESC1,
    SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) Revenue
FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f
JOIN Dim_Product p ON f.Product_ID=p.Product_ID
GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
